sources.primary_title: LEAP 2026 Opens Tomorrow: What to Watch as the Global Technology Community Gathers in Riyadh
sources.verified_angle_summary: LEAP 2026 has expanded its cultural and networking program, LEAP Nights, through a new strategic partnership with F1 Saudi Arabia Motorsport. The collaboration bridges technology and motorsport, offering LEAP attendees an exclusive 20 percent early-bird discount on tickets for the Formula 1 STC Saudi Arabian Grand Prix 2027 in Jeddah. LEAP Nights will feature 60 events across more than 15 venues in Riyadh from August 30 to September 4, extending the tech conference's reach into the city. The partnership highlights LEAP's broader integration with major Saudi entertainment and sporting events, providing a unique angle that moves beyond standard exhibition announcements.
